schema.description: A five-step system for local Nigerian businesses to grow online: Google Business Profile, website, social media, ads, and WhatsApp conversion.

mainEntity.name: How do I grow my business online in Uyo?

acceptedAnswer.text: Follow a five-step order: claim and optimize your Google Business Profile, build a mobile-first website, post consistently on social media, run targeted ads once the foundation is solid, then convert traffic with landing pages and an automated WhatsApp funnel. Skipping the order is the most common reason ads and social media fail to bring in new customers.

mainEntity.name: What is the first step to grow a local service business online?

acceptedAnswer.text: Claim your Google Business Profile first. It is free, it is how customers find local services like electricians and solar installers on Google, and it works as a 24-hour storefront before you spend any money on ads.

mainEntity.name: Should I run Facebook or Google ads before building a website?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Ads amplify what already exists. Sending paid traffic to an empty Google Business Profile or a slow, unclear website wastes ad spend. Fix your profile, website, and social presence first, then turn on ads.

mainEntity.name: Why do WhatsApp leads go cold in Nigerian small businesses?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most leads message on WhatsApp after clicking an ad or finding a business online, but without an automated welcome message and a fast follow-up sequence, they move on to a competitor within hours. An automated WhatsApp funnel keeps leads warm until a human can respond.
